title: [WT-19a] Test: pre-flip worktree dry run (parallel landings, conflict resume, candidate gate)
definitionOfDone: scripts/tests/worktree-e2e.cjs is the only changed file. It has WT-19 step 2's CLI and a `cli` fake-CLI mode, prints one ok/FAILED line per scenario, exits 1 on any failure, and never prints SKIP.

Parallel: two seats launched at once land task-a and task-b. main gains exactly two commits, `git log --first-parent main` is linear, every refs/heads/main reflog entry is a fast-forward, local main equals the bare origin's main, and neither worktree holds .moe.

Conflict-resume: task-c's first attempt ends unlanded (main does not move; finalize_attempt records outcome 'unlanded'). Its second session gets the LANDING-CONFLICT prompt, resolves it and lands. History stays linear and fast-forward only.

Control follows: after every landing, moe/control's HEAD equals main and `git status` is clean, MOE_CONTROL_ADVANCED is printed, and none of WT-13's MOE_CONTROL_NOT_FOLLOWING, MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND or MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_DIVERGED appears.

Gate: every landing runs `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint` in the wrapper's gate workspace and prints the wrapper's gate-pass line. The gate string is prefixed with a probe proving the workspace holds no .moe/.

The verification command exits 0 with <parent-tmp> under /mnt/d/moe-scratch, run from a HEAD snapshot that contains WT-10M's landing. The summary records that sha, the output tail and each scenario's wall time.
taskRails: Run from a HEAD snapshot with the new file copied in and cmp-checked (Serena gotcha-gate-hermetic-snapshot-from-wsl). This keeps 31187ec1's and WT-14's in-flight wrapper edits out.
Handle any missing fake-proxy behaviour inside the new file.
A wrapper defect becomes a bug: row in this epic, with the output. Never weaken an assertion.
reopenReason: Superseded by WT-19b (task-48aafb880ede4b22a3e26115c07f8470). The human decided on 11-02 "keep main PR-only, land on a branch", so this project's worktree target is consolidationBranch 'moe/work-2026-10-24' and there is no migration landing. This row's DoD asserted on main and required a post-WT-10M snapshot. WT-19b keeps the same scope, depends on WT-13 and uses a slash-named non-main target. No plan was submitted and no work was lost.

comments.content:
@architect-0fcb7226 HOLD: please don't submit a plan for this row. It is superseded by a human decision just now: "keep main PR-only, land on a branch".

What changes:
- This project's worktree target becomes consolidationBranch 'moe/work-2026-10-24'. It is slash-named, it isn't main, and it already contains everything.
- So there is no migration landing, and WT-10M is no longer a flip prerequisite.

This row's DoD assumes the opposite on both counts. DoD 2-4 assert on main, and DoD 6 requires a snapshot containing WT-10M's landing. A DoD can't be edited, so I'm archiving this row and re-filing it as **WT-19b**. WT-19b keeps your text, with three changes:
- It depends on WT-13.
- Its fixture target is a slash-named non-main branch, while main must never move.
- Its snapshot must contain WT-13.

Your exploration carries over unchanged. The new id follows in #architects.
